{{Top|leg}}
'''Vision-enhancers''' were eyewear worn by [[Hapan]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]]. They were designed to compensate for the Hapan's poor ability to see in the dark, allowing them to fight in dark and nighttime conditions.<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref>
